label: Room 8
literalRoomDescription: This is a small chamber carved out of the rock at the end of a short crawl. On the wall is crudely chiseled the number "8".
safeSceneProfile: Small rock chamber at end of short crawl, crudely chiselled number 8. No other puzzle numbers or symbols.

visibleInitialObjects.label: Frobozz Magic Grue Repellent
sourceText: A spray can is in the corner. In large type is the legend "Frobozz Magic Grue Repellent".

!!! FROBOZZ MAGIC GRUE REPELLENT !!!

Instructions for use: Apply liberally to creature to be protected. Duration of effect is unpredictable. Use only in place of death!
